content: Paasika Ba7aale
Isra7eele asay Gibxefe keyida nam7antho laythan koyro ageenan Siina mela biittan Goday Museko haysada yaagis;
“Isra7eele asay Paasika Ba7aale iya qamman boncho.
Ha ageenan tammanne oyddantho gallasan iya qamman omarsi iya woga ubbaadanne iya kiita ubbaada boncho” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Musey Isra7eele asay Paasika Ba7aale bonchana mela entaw odis.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, Isra7eele asay koyro ageenan tammanne oyddantho gallasan, omarsi Siina mela biittan Paasika Ba7aale bonchidosona.
Shin entafe baggati aha bochidi tunida gisho he gallas Paasika Ba7aale bonchanaw danda7ibookona. Hessa gisho, enti he gallas Musekonne Aaronako yidi,
“Nuuni aha bochida gisho tunida, shin he qamman hara Isra7eele asaara Godaas yarsho yarshonna mela ayis digetido?” yaagidosona.
Musey zaaridi, “Goday hintebaa taw odana gakanaw gam7ishite” yaagis.
Goday Museko,
“Isra7eele asaako haysada yaaga; hintefe woyko hinte kochaafe oonika aha bochidi tuniko woyko ogetidabaa gidiko, Paasika Ba7aale bonchanaw danda7ees.
Nam7antho ageenan tammanne oyddantho gallas omarsi Paasika Ba7aale boncho. Paasika dorsa uytharanne camo boncora mo.
Sa7ay wontana gakanaw dorsa ashuwape aybika attofo; qassi iya meqethafe issuwaka menthofo. Paasika Baaliya woga ubbaa ootho.
Shin geeshshinne ogetonna as Paasika bonchona ixiko, I ta asaa giddofe kuretto. Godaa yarshuwa iya qamman yarshiboona gisho ba nagaraa gisho pirda ekees.
“Hinte giddon de7iya bete asi Paasika Ba7aale bonchanaw koyko, Paasika wogaada boncho. Betanchoynne biitta aawu na7i ubbay he wogaatho ootho” yaagis.
Tama Shaara
Geeshsha Dunkaaney toketida gallas shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya ma7is. Omarsafe doomidi, wonta gakanaw Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bollara de7iya shaaray tama daanees.
Hessada gallas gallas shaaray ma77ees; qamma qamma he shaaray tamada poo7ees.
He shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bollafe dendiya wode ubban Isra7eele asay banta dunkaanida gutaape dendoosona. Qassi he shaaray wodhiya bessan Isra7eele asay dunkaanosona.
Isra7eele asay Godaa kiitan gutaape dendoosona; qassi Godaa kiitan dunkaanosona. Shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bolla gam7iya wode ubban banta dunkaanida gutan gam7oosona.
Shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bolla daro gallas gam7ikoka, Isra7eele asay Godaa kiita naagosonape attishin, awuka bookona.
Issi issi toho shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bolla guutha gallas gam7ees. Gidikoka enti Godaa kiitan dunkaanosona; qassi Godaa kiitan gutaape dendoosona.
Issi issi toho shaaray omarsafe wontana gakanaw xalaala gam7ees; shaaray dendiya wode enti dendoosona. Gallas gidin, qamma gidin, shaaray dendiya wode enti dendoosona.

Shaaray Geeshsha Dunkaaniya bolla nam7u gallas gidin woyko issi ageena woyko issi laythi gam7in Isra7eele asay banta dunkaanida gutan gam7osonape attishin, bookona. Shin shaaray dendiya wode entika dendoosona.
Goday Muse Kiittidaysada enti Godaa kiitan dunkaanosona qassi Godaa kiitan gutaape dendidi boosona.
